notes: Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): the four Jobber pages blocked to the fetch tool (home, pricing, the Core plan help article and the field service product page) were each read once in a real browser; those snapshots settle 23 of the first 31 claims (21 true, 2 wrong). The pricing snapshot shows the one-user (Just me) view only, with a Monthly or Annual toggle: Core $49/mo or $29/mo billed annually, Connect $139/mo or $99/mo, Grow $199/mo or $149/mo; $49, $139 and $199 are read as the month-to-month prices because they sit beside the billed-annually price under that toggle (the page's own line says save up to 25% with annual billing, which does not fit Core's $49 to $29; reviewer may want to confirm). Team-size prices (five, 10 and 15 users) were not captured, so C07 to C12 and the new C32 and C33 stay unverifiable. C03 ($39 Core) is wrong; its cause is a FieldPulse comparison blog that both answers cite. C13 ($65 starting price) is wrong on its lower end; no cited page read carries it (fieldservicesoftware.io, founding.dev and the Housecall Pro HVAC page were read for Housecall Pro and do not, bdrco answered 403, Reddit is disallowed by robots.txt, and getjobber.com/industries/hvac/ was not requested because that host blocked the fetch tool twice). C04 ($119 for the most useful features) names no plan, so it stays unverifiable. Added in pass 2: C32 (Plus plan) and C33 ($29 to $699 range), and a C25 instance from a Claude answer. Hedged lines, capability claims (route optimization, offline mode, financing) and G2 rankings were not coded.
